svg.title: 90-day remediation plan — P0 → P3, sequenced with dependencies and owners

g.text: 90-day remediation plan — P0 → P3, sequenced with dependencies and owners
Day 1 = Mon 2026-08-03 · 12 working weeks · weekends closed · durations in working days
Every item traces to a file:LINE in the evidence base. Owner is named in each bar.
P0-1 — the single highest-severity finding in the audit.
`/chat` and `/reports*` deliberately auth-free. `auth.py:17-20` says the design is safe
the ports are private — the compose bindings mean they are not. One line per service:
`- "127.0.0.1:8080:8080"`. Nothing depends on this technically, but it is what keeps every
finding below from being remotely exploitable while it is being fixed.
`core/sql_guard.py:57-126` scans into two buffers; `:129-157` validates `bare` but
returns `cleaned`. A reproduced input `SELECT E'\''…; ATTACH …` defeats
stacked-statement check (`:142`) and the keyword blocklist (`:146`). Replace the scanner with a
real parser, or at minimum model `E'…'`, `$$…$$`, quoted function names and DuckDB replacement
scans on string literals. Containment today rests entirely on `engines/sql.py:124-132`
`core/net.py:99` discards the IPs `resolve_public_ips()` just validated and httpx
re-resolves when it connects at `:137`. Pin the address (connect-to / custom transport). While
in the file: add `100.64.0.0/10` to `_ip_is_blocked` (`:47-55`), give `socket.getaddrinfo`
(`:76`) a timeout, and add a total-request deadline (the `read` timeout is per-read, so a
`engines/sql.py:201,206` runs DuckDB synchronously inside `async def`, on a single
uvicorn worker (`Dockerfile:52`) — one slow query stalls
`main.py:184-199` bounds neither `messages` nor the base64 `image`/`pdf` strings, and
`main.py:47-53` installs CORS as the only middleware — Starlette adds no default body limit.
Also bound `LiveGeneration.events` (`main.py:85,97`), which retains every token frame for the
generation's whole life, and make `core/archive.py:216`'s byte budget global rather than
httpx has already buffered the entire
response — the cap protects the prompt, not the process.
conv_owner = None`, so `main.py:343` skips the 404 on any DB error. The comment at `:336-337`
1 141 passing tests run only when a human types `README.md:298-302`. Wire the three existing
commands first, then add `next lint`, `npx tsc --noEmit` and a coverage floor. Delete rather
than bless the 5 tests that cannot fail: `test_search_off.py:9-29` (re-implements the gate
`sync-worker/requirements.txt` already caps majors and `frontend/package-lock.json` is fully
locked — adopt the sync-worker regime, then digest-pin `nvcr.io/nvidia/vllm:26.05-py3`
(`Dockerfile:14`) so the deployment stops depending on "never `docker compose pull`"
`requirements-dev.txt` — without the first, 12 test files fail at collection on a clean host.
are client-supplied (`history.py:92-97`), so a recreated id inherits
`syncworker/storage.py:140` creates every warehouse table with no PRIMARY KEY and no
index, so the upsert `DELETE … WHERE Id IN (…)` (`:156`) is a full table scan on every batch,
`db.py:195-205` executes 16 DDL statements plus a full-table de-dup `DELETE`
`auth.py:48`, `health.py:79`, `main.py:36`); one `POST /chat` pays it at least six times.
Migrate once in `lifespan` (`main.py:27-38`) and cache. `auth.py:48` `_oldest_user()` also
18 of the template's 43 variables reach no container at all — there is no `env_file:` in
`docker-compose.yml`. `.env.bak-205921` sits plaintext in the working tree (gitignored, mode
42 broad `except Exception` handlers swallow errors across `orchestrator/app`;
`main.py:161` and `:676` use `contextlib.suppress` around a persist, so a lost answer is
silent. No correlation id propagates browser → orchestrator → engine → model.
Three of the eight critical flows have no end-to-end coverage at all.
— `engines/rag.py` (151 LOC) has zero tests; `run_rag_engine` has no caller
in the suite, so LanceDB search, the Qwen3-Reranker load path and the citation contract
out to `pandoc --pdf-engine=weasyprint`) never execute, so the `.docx`/`.pdf` artefacts the
README advertises are never produced in CI.
NL → SQL → guard → DuckDB as a composition
returns a benign `SELECT`, so nothing proves a model emitting `DROP TABLE opportunities`
produces an SSE `error` frame rather than a query. Also join the two SSE halves: no test feeds
`docker-compose.yml:25` sets a ≲0.60 GPU-fraction ceiling, but `--profile vision`
further GPU reservation for the in-process reranker (`:283-289`, `RERANK_ENABLED: "true"`
`:244`) that sits outside the budget entirely. The compose header comment `:21-24` and
`README.md:283-288` both repeat the stale 0.53 sum that omits `vllm-vision`.
documents `/login`, `middleware.ts` and the `ts_session` cookie (all removed on 2026-07-28),
`:69-72` documents a model picker that now chooses effort, and `:29` gives an
`ORCHESTRATOR_URL` default that is wrong inside the compose network.
models and context windows with no "superseded" marker. `.env.example:4` still names a model
P0-1 Bind published ports to 127.0.0.1 (or put authN in front) · Platform
M0 · host no longer reachable from the LAN
P1 · WEEKS 1-3 · guard correctness, blocking I/O, resource caps
P1-1 Fix the sql_guard E-string desync — checks run on `bare`, `cleaned` executes · Backend
P1-2 Pin the SSRF-validated IP — close the resolve-then-connect TOCTOU · Backend
P1-3 Off-load the blocking DuckDB call to a thread · Backend
P1-4 Cap the request body (ChatRequest fields + an ASGI size limit) · Platform
P1-5 Stream and cap fetch bodies instead of buffering resp.content · Backend
P1-6 Fix the fall-open conversation-ownership check · Backend
M1 · P1 closed — no fall-open guard, no event-loop stall
P2 · WEEKS 4-8 · CI, reproducibility, data integrity, observability
P2-1 Add CI (GitHub Actions): pytest + vitest + next lint + tsc on every push · Platform
P2-2 Lockfile + upper-bound pinning for the orchestrator; digest-pin the base image · Platform
P2-3 FKs or explicit cleanup for the 4 orphaning tables · Data
P2-4 Index the DuckDB Id columns · Data
P2-5 Stop re-running the schema + migration on every connect() call site · Data
P2-6 Remove the dead AWS config from .env.example; delete the plaintext .env backup · Platform
P2-7 Correlation IDs + structured logs: browser → orchestrator → engine → model · Backend
M2 · CI green on every push; builds reproducible
P3 · WEEKS 9-12 · end-to-end assurance, GPU budget, doc drift
P3-1 Integration / E2E tests for the 8 critical paths · QA
P3-2 GPU budget enforcement — the vision profile breaches the stated ceiling · Platform
P3-3 Close docs / CHANGELOG drift · Docs
M3 · end of week 12 — 8 critical paths covered end-to-end
M4 · Day 90 — re-run the full audit
nothing on the box answers an unauthenticated caller
no guard fails open; no blocking call on the event loop
CI green on every push; builds reproducible; no orphan rows
8 critical paths covered E2E; GPU budget enforced
◇ = milestone. An arrow into a bar is a hard dependency
P0-1 → P1-1 → P2-1 → P2-7 → P3-1 = 60 working days.
P1-1 (sql_guard) and P2-1 (CI) are the two items that gate everything
downstream; start both the day their predecessor lands.
